tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get the full amended text of one article of the EU AI Act, including lettered numbers such as "60a".

tools.name: get_recital
tools.description: Get the full text of one recital of the EU AI Act.

tools.name: get_annex
tools.description: Get the full text of one annex of the EU AI Act (roman numeral).

tools.name: get_definition
tools.description: Get the Article 3 definition of a term used in the EU AI Act.

tools.name: search_text
tools.description: Full-text search over articles, recitals and annexes of the EU AI Act. Returns ranked matches with snippets.

tools.name: get_obligations
tools.description: List the obligations for a role under the EU AI Act, optionally filtered by risk tier.

tools.name: get_deadlines
tools.description: Show which EU AI Act obligations and phases are in force or pending as of a given date.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Report a problem or a gap in this server's data (a wrong text, a missing amendment, a broken answer). One-way: no reply is sent.

tools.name: assess_compliance
tools.description: Run the EU AI Act compliance assessment: given the entity's answers (same decision tree as the interactive checker on euaiactlaw.com), returns the applicable roles, risk classification, full obligation list with legal basis and deadlines, and notes (e.g. Annex I Section B reduced regime, open-source

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: assess_compliance · Public sink: send_feedback · Destructive: assess_compliance.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: assess_compliance · Public sink: send_feedback · Destructive: assess_compliance

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
